mapper.select: WITH occupancy AS ( SELECT bed.id AS bed_id, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM room_exchange_participant_lock exchange_lock JOIN room_assignment exchange_residency ON exchange_residency.student_id=exchange_lock.student_id AND exchange_residency.assignment_status='ACTIVE' AND exchange_residency.bed_id=bed.id ) THEN 'ROOM_EXCHANGE' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM room_assignment residency WHERE residency.bed_id=bed.id AND residency.assignment_status='ACTIVE' ) THEN 'RESIDENCY' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bed_assignment assignment WHERE assignment.bed_id=bed.id AND assignment.assignment_status='ACTIVE' ) THEN 'ALLOCATION' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bed_confirmation_request confirmation WHERE confirmation.declared_bed_id=bed.id AND confirmation.request_status='PENDING' ) THEN 'PENDING_CONFIRMATION' ELSE 'AVAILABLE' END AS occupancy_source, COALESCE( ( SELECT exchange_residency.student_id FROM room_exchange_participant_lock exchange_lock JOIN room_assignment exchange_residency ON exchange_residency.student_id=exchange_lock.student_id AND exchange_residency.assignment_status='ACTIVE' AND exchange_residency.bed_id=bed.id ORDER BY exchange_lock.exchange_id LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT residency.student_id FROM room_assignment residency WHERE residency.bed_id=bed.id AND residency.assignment_status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY residency.assigned_at DESC, residency.id DESC LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT assignment.student_id FROM bed_assignment assignment WHERE assignment.bed_id=bed.id AND assignment.assignment_status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY assignment.assigned_at DESC, assignment.id DESC LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT confirmation.student_id FROM bed_confirmation_request confirmation WHERE confirmation.declared_bed_id=bed.id AND confirmation.request_status='PENDING' ORDER BY confirmation.submitted_at, confirmation.id LIMIT 1 ) ) AS occupant_student_id FROM bed WHERE bed.room_id=#{roomId} AND bed.operational_status<>'RETIRED' ) SELECT occupancy.bed_id, CASE WHEN occupancy.occupancy_source='AVAILABLE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS occupied, occupancy.occupancy_source, occupancy.occupant_student_id, student.student_number AS occupant_student_number, student.student_name AS occupant_student_name, CASE occupancy.occupancy_source WHEN 'ROOM_EXCHANGE' THEN CONCAT('该床位由', COALESCE(student.student_name, '学生'), '使用，且正在办理寝室交换') WHEN 'RESIDENCY' THEN CONCAT('该床位已有在住学生：', COALESCE(student.student_name, '未知学生')) WHEN 'ALLOCATION' THEN CONCAT('该床位已分配给：', COALESCE(student.student_name, '未知学生')) WHEN 'PENDING_CONFIRMATION' THEN CONCAT('该床位正在等待', COALESCE(student.student_name, '学生'), '的实际床位核查') ELSE NULL END AS blocking_reason FROM occupancy LEFT JOIN student ON student.id=occupancy.occupant_student_id ORDER BY occupancy.bed_id
